en: This is a sepia-toned postcard featuring a panoramic view over the town of Waldheim. The foreground displays a grand historic villa with distinctive roofs, while the midground and background show the old town with prominent historic buildings, a clock tower, and the surrounding hilly landscape. The text 'Blick auf Waldheim' is printed in red at the top, translating to 'View of Waldheim.' The left margin also contains publisher information in smaller text.
